title: Speed/Feed Product Autopilot
brief: Wire PhysicsFusionOrchestratorEngine for Tier 2+ converged recommendations (not just single-pass). Auto material-to-ISO group resolution. Auto tier selection based on input completeness. Result confidence reporting to user. Must wire through Physics Fusion, not just legacy single-pass.

units.title: Wire PhysicsFusionOrchestratorEngine into automation chain: input validation, engine dispatch, result collection
Implement auto material-to-ISO group resolution: material name/grade lookup, fuzzy match, ISO-P/M/K/N/S/H classification
Implement auto tier selection: assess input completeness, select Tier 2/3/4 based on available parameters
Implement result confidence reporting: convergence quality, source agreement, parameter sensitivity indicators
End-to-end test: natural language query through entry router to converged Physics Fusion result with confidence score

exit_conditions: PhysicsFusionOrchestratorEngine wired into automation chain (not legacy single-pass)
Material-to-ISO group auto-resolution working for common materials
Tier auto-selection picks correct tier based on input completeness
Confidence reporting shows convergence quality and source agreement
Token budget stays within <5K for product autopilot chain
